categories.label: Most strikeouts
categories.explainer: Total strikeouts this season — a volume number, so it rewards staying healthy and pitching deep as much as missing bats.

categories.label: Hardest to hit
categories.explainer: Opponent batting average — how often hitters actually get a hit off him.

categories.label: Best control
categories.explainer: Walks per nine innings — who gives up the fewest free passes.

categories.label: Workhorses
categories.explainer: Innings pitched — who keeps taking the ball and working deep into games.

categories.label: Lowest ERA
categories.explainer: Earned runs allowed per nine innings — the classic run-prevention number.

categories.label: FIP
categories.explainer: FIP — a truer read on pitching skill; lower is better.
